# Ultimate Fishing Academy

> An online video course that teaches recreational fishing, taught by Matt Watson, host of the Ultimate Fishing TV series. 22 modules and 130+ lessons covering gear, knots and rigs, finding fish, boating and anchoring, bait and presentation, and more. Built for New Zealand anglers.

## The course
- [Course overview and enrolment](https://www.ultimatefishingacademy.com/): what's included, modules, pricing, 30-day money-back guarantee
- [Free lessons](https://www.ultimatefishingacademy.com/#free-lessons): watch 3 Academy lessons free

## Articles
- [All articles](https://www.ultimatefishingacademy.com/articles/): free guides from Matt Watson
- [How to keep your snapper fresh from boat to plate](https://www.ultimatefishingacademy.com/articles/how-to-keep-snapper-fresh/)
